st-hr-gram-panchayats.name: Gram Panchayats of Haryana
st-hr-gram-panchayats.description: The village-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Haryana, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-hr-gram-panchayats.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-hr-gram-panchayats.notes: State-wise seat/panchayat count could not be sourced in this research pass: lgdirectory.gov.in's per-state query reports (globalViewStatewiseLocalBody.do and the Download Directory PRI reports) require solving a CAPTCHA to retrieve data, which is outside permitted tooling; only the LGD homepage's national totals (see Local Government of India (aggregate)) were accessible without one. No alternate state-wise secondary source was found before the session's web-search budget was exhausted.

st-hr-panchayat-samitis.name: Panchayat Samitis of Haryana
st-hr-panchayat-samitis.description: The intermediate (block) tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Haryana, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-hr-panchayat-samitis.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-hr-panchayat-samitis.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated).

st-hr-zila-parishads.name: Zila Parishads of Haryana
st-hr-zila-parishads.description: The district-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Haryana, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-hr-zila-parishads.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-hr-zila-parishads.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated). Typically one Zila Parishad per district, so the count should be close to (but need not exactly equal) the district count.

st-hr-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Haryana
st-hr-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of Haryana (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-hr-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-hr-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

st-hr-assembly.name: Haryana Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha)
st-hr-assembly.description: The unicameral state legislature of Haryana, 90 members elected by first-past-the-post from single-member constituencies for a 5-year term, meeting at the Palace of Assembly, Chandigarh. Currently the 15th Haryana Assembly, with a BJP government.
st-hr-assembly.head: st-hr-pos-speaker

st-hr-dept-home.name: Home Department
st-hr-dept-home.description: Oversees the state police, prisons, home guards and internal-security administration, and handles law-and-order policy.

st-hr-dept-agriculture-and-welfare.name: Department of Agriculture and Welfare
st-hr-dept-agriculture-and-welfare.description: Runs extension services, input subsidies and crop-support schemes for farmers and oversees agricultural policy and marketing infrastructure.

st-hr-dept-animal-husbandry-and-dairying.name: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying
st-hr-dept-animal-husbandry-and-dairying.description: Runs veterinary services, dairy development and livestock health programmes to support animal-owning farmers.

st-hr-dept-archaeology-and-museums.name: Directorate of Archaeology & Museums
st-hr-dept-archaeology-and-museums.description: Protects and maintains the state's archaeological sites, monuments and museums.

st-hr-dept-higher-education.name: Department of Higher Education
st-hr-dept-higher-education.description: Administers government colleges and universities and funds/regulates higher and university education in the state.

st-hr-dept-school-education.name: Department of School Education
st-hr-dept-school-education.description: Runs government schools and administers the state's school curriculum, teacher recruitment and mid-day meal scheme.

st-hr-dept-elementary-education.name: Department of Elementary Education
st-hr-dept-elementary-education.description: Runs government primary and elementary schools and universal-education programmes.

st-hr-dept-electronics-and-information-t.name: Electronics & Information Technology Department
st-hr-dept-electronics-and-information-t.description: Drives e-governance, IT infrastructure and the promotion of the state's IT/ITeS industry.

st-hr-dept-environment.name: Department of Environment
st-hr-dept-environment.description: Regulates pollution control and environmental clearances and runs environment-protection programmes.

st-hr-dept-excise-and-taxation.name: Excise & Taxation Department
st-hr-dept-excise-and-taxation.description: Collects state excise duty, VAT/GST and other indirect taxes, and licenses the liquor trade.

st-hr-dept-finance.name: Finance Department Haryana
st-hr-dept-finance.description: Prepares the state budget, manages treasury and public debt, and controls government expenditure and pay/pension rules.

st-hr-dept-fisheries.name: Fisheries Department
st-hr-dept-fisheries.description: Promotes inland and aquaculture fisheries, issues fishing licences and runs fisherfolk welfare schemes.

st-hr-dept-food-civil-supplies-and-consu.name: Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department
st-hr-dept-food-civil-supplies-and-consu.description: Runs the public distribution system (ration shops), procures foodgrain and enforces consumer-protection and weights-and-measures law.

st-hr-dept-forests.name: Haryana Forests Department
st-hr-dept-forests.description: Manages state forests and wildlife sanctuaries, enforces forest and wildlife protection law, and runs afforestation programmes.

st-hr-dept-health.name: Health Department Haryana
st-hr-dept-health.description: Runs government hospitals and primary health centres, public-health programmes and disease control for citizens.

st-hr-dept-irrigation-and-water-resource.name: Irrigation & Water Resources Department
st-hr-dept-irrigation-and-water-resource.description: Builds and maintains irrigation canals, dams and river-water infrastructure.

st-hr-dept-labour.name: Labour Department Haryana
st-hr-dept-labour.description: Enforces labour law, registers factories/establishments, runs the Employees' State Insurance and welfare boards, and resolves industrial disputes.

st-hr-dept-police.name: Haryana Police Department
st-hr-dept-police.description: Maintains law and order, investigates crime and provides public safety and traffic policing.

st-hr-dept-prisons.name: Prisons Department
st-hr-dept-prisons.description: Runs the state's jails and correctional/rehabilitation services for prisoners.

st-hr-dept-information-public-relations-.name: Directorate of Information, Public Relations & Languages Department
st-hr-dept-information-public-relations-.description: Promotes and regulates the teaching and official use of the state's languages.

st-hr-dept-public-works.name: Public Works Department
st-hr-dept-public-works.description: Builds and maintains government buildings, roads and bridges (Buildings & Roads).

st-hr-dept-revenue-and-disaster-manageme.name: Revenue and Disaster Management Department
st-hr-dept-revenue-and-disaster-manageme.description: Coordinates disaster preparedness, relief and rehabilitation across the state.

st-hr-dept-rural-development.name: Rural Development Department
st-hr-dept-rural-development.description: Funds and monitors rural infrastructure and livelihood schemes implemented through Panchayati Raj institutions.

st-hr-dept-tourism.name: Haryana Tourism Department
st-hr-dept-tourism.description: Promotes tourist destinations, runs state tourism corporations/hotels and markets the state to visitors.

st-hr-dept-town-and-country-planning.name: Department of Town & Country Planning
st-hr-dept-town-and-country-planning.description: Prepares statutory master plans and regulates land use and urban estates.

st-hr-dept-state-transport.name: Department of State Transport
st-hr-dept-state-transport.description: Regulates road transport and issues driving licences and vehicle registrations.

st-hr-dept-treasuries-and-accounts.name: Treasuries & Accounts Department
st-hr-dept-treasuries-and-accounts.description: Manages the state's treasury network that disburses government payments and pensions.

st-hr-dept-women-and-child-development.name: Women and Child Development Department
st-hr-dept-women-and-child-development.description: Runs anganwadi/ICDS child-nutrition centres, women's welfare and child-protection schemes.

st-hr-dept-public-health-engineering.name: Public Health Engineering Department
st-hr-dept-public-health-engineering.description: Provides piped drinking water and sanitation infrastructure, mainly in rural areas.

st-hr-dept-archives.name: Haryana Archives Department
st-hr-dept-archives.description: Preserves the state's official archival records.

st-hr-dept-government-of-transport-regul.name: Government of Haryana Transport Department ( Regulatory Wing)
st-hr-dept-government-of-transport-regul.description: Regulates road transport, runs the state road transport corporation/undertaking and issues driving licences and vehicle registrations.

st-hr-dept-civil-aviation.name: Civil Aviation Department
st-hr-dept-civil-aviation.description: Operates and licenses state-owned airstrips/heliports and coordinates air connectivity and VIP flight operations.

st-hr-dept-development-and-panchayats.name: Development & Panchayats Department
st-hr-dept-development-and-panchayats.description: Oversees Panchayati Raj institutions (village, block and district panchayats) and rural local self-government.

st-hr-dept-economic-and-statistical-anal.name: Department of Economic and Statistical Analysis
st-hr-dept-economic-and-statistical-anal.description: Compiles the state's official economic statistics, national/state income estimates and survey data.

st-hr-dept-horticulture.name: Horticulture Department
st-hr-dept-horticulture.description: Promotes fruit, vegetable and flower cultivation through extension services, subsidies and post-harvest infrastructure for farmers.

st-hr-dept-home-guards-and-civil-defence.name: Department of Home Guards & Civil Defence
st-hr-dept-home-guards-and-civil-defence.description: Coordinates civil-defence preparedness for emergencies and disasters.

st-hr-dept-industries-and-commerce.name: Department of Industries & Commerce
st-hr-dept-industries-and-commerce.description: Promotes industrial investment, runs industrial estates and administers incentives for MSMEs and large industry.

st-hr-dept-skill-development-and-industr.description: Runs Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) that provide vocational trade certification.

st-hr-dept-sports-and-youth-affairs.name: Department of Sports & Youth Affairs
st-hr-dept-sports-and-youth-affairs.description: Runs youth-development and volunteering programmes alongside sports.

st-hr-dept-supplies-and-disposals.name: Directorate of Supplies & Disposals

st-hr-dept-technical-education.name: Department of Technical Education
st-hr-dept-technical-education.description: Runs polytechnics and regulates technical/engineering education in the state.

st-hr-dept-chief-electrical-inspector.name: Chief Electrical Inspector Department
st-hr-dept-chief-electrical-inspector.description: Certifies electrical installations and enforces electrical-safety regulations.

st-hr-dept-citizen-resource-information.name: Citizen Resource Information Department
st-hr-dept-citizen-resource-information.description: Runs the state's citizen data/resource information and e-governance service delivery platform.

st-hr-dept-urban-local-bodies.name: Department of Urban Local Bodies
st-hr-dept-urban-local-bodies.description: Oversees municipal corporations, councils and committees that run civic services in towns and cities.

st-hr-dept-medical-education-and-researc.name: Department of Medical Education and Research (DMER)
st-hr-dept-medical-education-and-researc.description: Runs government medical, dental and nursing colleges and their attached teaching hospitals.
